PE1-19.hint: \((f+g)(x)\) means \(f(x) + g(x)\). For \(f\circ g\), put the whole expression \(g(x)\) wherever \(x\) appears in \(f\).
slips: Computing \(g(f(x))\) instead. In \(f\circ g\), the function \(g\) goes first.
Forgetting to distribute the \(2\) across both terms of \(x^{2} + 2\).
Multiplying \(f(x)\cdot g(x)\) when asked for the composition.
PE1-19.source: Practice Exam 1 review (the 38 questions on the Exam 1 review site, 172exam1review)
